master_history: DIAGKEY004 keyed write/read and tied decoding; LATFUSE018 real historical content; PAR-MEM-012 zero-read and wrong-key negative effects
dataset: Original SHA-pinned UCI PRSA2017 Beijing 12 physical stations, site owner real and event ordinal true source hour index
source_data_scope: March–April 2014 genuine already previously used FIT for training and May–June 2014 already exposed DEV for diagnostic only; no 2015–17 numerics
training_query: source-observed historical event a at lag in 16,64,128; distinct source-observed event b at a+1. Both measurements observed at their write time; no historical target values supplied to query or key.
model: Same original 98,326-parameter 410-FP32 source-owned model and same previously trained PAR-TIME-005 backbone per seed; no pretrained PAR-MEM-011 adapted checkpoint to avoid DEV feedback contamination
control: Both arms compute the same source model, per-event associative updates, query-key/read and current contextual no-matrix candidate. Aligned associative arm decodes sidecar memory; trained contextual arm decodes current source-embedding/time-key feature WITHOUT any aligned matrix value contribution. Both retain original underlying TAC fast summary/native 8x8 memory (not truly stateless), use all 98,326 live parameters, identical new sidecar bytes allocated, same full operator-shape traces.
matched_loss: mean two genuine past PM2.5 SmoothL1 losses + 0.35 event-order sign ranking softplus(logit) with temperature 0.25 and fixed margin 0.1 weighted by min(abs(true_pair_gap),1) +0.15 next-hour genuine 13D source physical target loss
ranking_loss: weighted softplus(0.1 -(prediction_a - prediction_b)*(observed_target_a-observed_target_b)/0.25); weights min(abs(genuine target gap),1) / (mean weight+1e-6); no query selection based on historical target difference
scoring: same-source genuine observed PM2.5 MAE both queries, exact old-event paired target-order accuracy, diagonal-vs-swapped absolute-error advantage, same checkpoint aligned-vs-zero read head ablation, next-hour source physical MAE, source current-value prior
optimizer: CPU FP32 AdamW lr 0.0005 weight_decay 0.001 foreach=false fused=false max_grad_norm=1, 36 updates seed/arm, exact frozen source order, matching data and splits
original_precommit_sequence: commit source schedule BEFORE any fitting, original 10 model/optimizer/torch/Python RNG bundles BEFORE DEV scoring, original true-source DEV predictions and metric JSON before clean-checkout replay
complete_mathematical_FLOP_coverage: NOT YET CERTIFIED even if op-shape+supported FLOP traces match; omit fair head-to-head superiority claim
untouched_real_world_cohort: NOT IDENTIFIED OR OPENED; previously exposed 2014 DEV can only give exploratory diagnostic evidence
reproducibility: pretrained trained-backbone hashes, source archive SHA, trained optimizer RNG/checkpoint/output SHA, cold replay all original data
target_leakage_rule: old observed readings available in input history at earlier times, but never passed explicitly to the historical query. pair construction depends only on source ordinals, not observed target values
scientific_limit: No evidence of event-specific memory, real generalization or physical control until source authorized independent cohort and true trained stateless/GRU/SSM controls plus full FLOP match pass
